interface.defaultPrompt: Use SMURF to find the original source of an earlier technical decision in my configured MemPalace.
interface.longDescription: Connect MemPalace to OpenAI workflows. Retrieve source-grounded memories with read-only access and traceable references. Independent community-built, read-only local MCP connector for MemPalace. Supports lexical FTS5 search of configured sqlite_exact/rust_exact and Chroma SQLite indices, bounded source excerpts and wing allowlists. No database writes, background memory or network listener. Some ChatGPT execution modes do not expose local MCP; ordinary chats are not yet verified.
interface.shortDescription: Read-only MemPalace connector with traceable sources
